ST3-14.desc: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
[Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.

ST3-15.desc: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains Security Attack -3This Digimon checks 3 fewer security cards) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
[Security] All of your opponent's Digimon gain <Security Attack -1> (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card) for the turn.

ST3-16.desc: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -10000 DP for the turn.

ST4-03.desc: [On Play] Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a green Digimon card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, place it at the bottom of your deck.

ST4-04.desc: [When Attacking] If you attack an opponent's Digimon, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.

ST4-10.desc: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 level 6 or higher Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.

ST4-11.desc: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.

ST4-12.desc: [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack or block until the end of their next turn.

ST4-13.desc: [Main] <Digi-Burst 2> (Trash 2 of this Digimon's Digivolution cards to activate the effect below.) - Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

ST4-14.desc: [Your Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon becomes suspended, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory.

ST4-15.desc: [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, add this card to your hand.

ST4-16.desc: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to its owner's hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.

ST5-04.desc: [End of Opponent's Turn] If your opponent didn't attack with a Digimon this turn, trigger <Draw 1>. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

ST5-09.desc: [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, 1 of your Digimon gains <Blocker>. (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)

ST5-12.desc: [When Digivolving] Up to 2 of your Digimon gain <Reboot>  (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase) until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ST5-13.desc: [Main] <Digi-Burst 2> (Trash 2 of this Digimon's Digivolution cards to activate the effect below.) - 1 of your Digimon gets +4000 DP until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ST5-14.desc: [Opponent's Turn] When you use <Blocker> to suspend one of your Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to unsuspend 1 of your Digimon.

ST5-15.desc: [Main] Trigger <De-Digivolve 1> on up to 2 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash a card from the top of one of your opponent's Digimon. If it has no digivolution cards, or becomes a level 3 Digimon, you can't trash any more cards.)

ST5-16.desc: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 7 or less.

ST6-01.desc: [On Deletion] Trash the top 2 cards of your deck.

ST6-03.desc: [When Attacking] Trigger <Draw 1>. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.

ST6-04.desc: [On Play] You may return 1 purple Option card with a memory cost of 1 or 7 from your trash to your hand.

ST6-10.desc: [When Digivolving] You may return 1 purple Digimon card from your trash to your hand.

ST6-12.desc: [When Digivolving] Up to 2 of your Digimon gain <Retaliation> (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling) until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ST6-13.desc: [Main] <Digi-Burst 2> (Trash 2 of this Digimon's Digivolution cards to activate the effect below.) - Play 1 purple level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost.

ST6-14.desc: [Your Turn] When one of your Digimon is deleted, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory.

ST6-15.desc: [Main] You may delete 1 of your Digimon to delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
[Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.

ST6-16.desc: [Main] You may play 1 purple level 3 Digimon card and 1 purple level 4 Digimon card from your trash without paying their memory costs. Any [On Play] effects on Digimon played with this effect don't activate.
[Security] You may play 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost. Any [On Play] effects on Digimon played with this effect don't activate.

ST7-01.desc: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.

ST7-02.desc: [When Attacking] When this Digimon attacks a player, it gets +2000 DP for the turn

ST7-03.desc: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, trigger <Draw 1>. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

ST7-05.desc: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory.

ST7-06.desc: [On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

ST7-07.desc: [On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.

ST7-08.desc: [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, this Digimon gains <Security Attack +1> for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

ST7-09.desc: [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.

ST7-11.desc: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, if the number of cards in your security stack is less than or equal to your opponent's, 1 of your Digimon gains <Security Attack +1> for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.

ST7-12.desc: [Main] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 8000 or less and delete them.
[Security] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 8000 or less and delete them.

ST8-03.desc: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Dramon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.

ST8-04.desc: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, trigger <Draw 1>. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

ST8-05.desc: [When Attacking] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to its owner's hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.

ST8-06.desc: [On Play] Trigger <Draw 2>. (Draw 2 card from your deck.)

ST8-09.desc: [When Digivolving] This Digimon gains <Security Attack +1> (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card) for the turn.

ST8-10.desc: [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand, unsuspend this Digimon.

ST8-11.desc: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.

ST8-12.desc: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.

ST9-02.desc: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Free] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.

ST9-04.desc: [When Attacking] If you have a green Digimon in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.

ST9-05.desc: [When Digivolving] When DNA digivolving, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less to the bottom of its owner's deck.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] Unsuspend this Digimon.

ST9-06.desc: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower blue Digimon card and 1 level 4 or lower green Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying their memory costs.

ST9-14.desc: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to its owner's hand.

ST9-09.desc: [When Attacking] If you have a blue Digimon in play, <Draw 1>. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

ST9-10.desc: [On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

ST9-11.desc: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. When DNA digivolving, that Digimon doesn't unsuspend during its owner's next unsuspend phase.

ST9-13.desc: [When Digivolving] This Digimon gets +4000 DP for the turn.

ST9-15.desc: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, If you have a blue Digimon in play, 1 of your Digimon gains <Piercing> for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
